anomalies.observed: C44 is a 100 nF X7R 0603 decoupling capacitor on +3V3/GND, but its description and an explicit Tolerance field say ±20%. Every other 100 nF X7R 0603 part in the design (for example C43 and C45) is ±10%, and C44's own footprint and libsource still reflect ±10%.
anomalies.expected: A ±10% X7R 100 nF part consistent with the rest of the 100 nF X7R 0603 family and with the component's own footprint/libsource metadata.

evidence.quote: (libsource (lib "Coert-Vonk") (part "CAP X7R 100nF ±10% 100V 0603 Murata") (description "0.1 µF ±10% 100V Ceramic Capacitor X7R 0603 (1608 Metric)"))

anomalies.impact: Minor. A ±20% 100 nF decoupling capacitor on the 3.3 V rail is electrically acceptable, but the BOM tolerance is inconsistent with the part family and may indicate an unintended substitution.

anomalies.observed: The TPS62933 buck regulator's EN pin (pad 2) has no net and is flagged no_connect. Nothing in the design drives or pulls it.
anomalies.expected: EN should be tied to VIN through a divider or pull-up, or otherwise driven, so the regulator's enable state is defined.
anomalies.impact: The enable state of the 24 V to 5 V buck depends on its internal default, so the 5 V rail may not start reliably. This would break the ESP32 and the 3.3 V LDO supply.

anomalies.observed: The low-side N-MOSFET T2 (IRLR2905) that switches the main 24 V pump has its gate node /G_PUMP pulled up to +3V3 through R5 (10 kΩ). The equivalent gate node for the ATO N-MOSFET T5 is pulled down to GND through R12.
anomalies.expected: A low-side N-MOSFET gate is normally pulled down so the load is off at power-up or when the driver is floating. A pull-up to +3V3 would enable the pump whenever the pre-driver is off.
anomalies.impact: If this is not intentional, the main circulation pump could run at power-up or during MCU reset, which is a safety and behaviour concern for the water loop.

parsed.summary: The most concrete deviation is C44, a 100 nF decoupling capacitor whose description and Tolerance field say ±20% while every sibling part is ±10%. Two weaker candidates are a floating TPS62933 EN pin and a pump gate pulled up to +3V3; both could be reference-design choices, so they are lower confidence.
